parameters.name: Device
parameters.description: The list of devices to remove from the group.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The device name of the device you want to remove from the group. You can specify up to 200 device names.

sub_parameters.name: ProductKey
sub_parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device you want to remove from the group belongs. You can specify up to 200 ProductKeys.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
